exposure: Labor induction with 10 mg vaginal dinoprostone insert
Labor induction with oral misoprostol 50 µg/4 h
cohort: 396 women with a Bishop score <6 undergoing labor induction
finding: Labor induction with vaginal dinoprostone was independently associated with an increased rate of cesarean sections compared to oral misoprostol in women with an unfavorable cervix.
mod_finding: Vaginal dinoprostone was associated with an increased rate of cesarean sections compared to oral misoprostol for labor induction.
